archetypes.name: dyn-pause-order
archetypes.rationale: Folded /design fences depend on pause-safe stdout and sentinel ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 0 route/init and Step 1d.5 entry paths for pause-order regressions. Check that route-state and completion sentinels are written before any pause save, and that stdout directives are emitted only after the corresponding work succeeds. Pay special attention to init failure and brainstorm skip precedence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
